description.en:
The machine-consumable OWL 2 form of the CoreSense Ontology. CSO is
        authored by hand to match the SysML v2 model in sysml/ and the prose definitions in
        CS-115, which remain the conceptual source of record.

definition.value: A function is a transformation that maps specific inputs to outputs.
A system is an entity represented by a tuple (C, R), where C is a set of components and R is the set of binary relations between them.
An action is a performance that an agent executes or commands in order to bring about a change in an extended system.

comment.en: Editorial definition; the SysML v2 model reuses the standard library element Actions::Action.

definition.value: The aspect of its referent that a modelet represents.

Model metadata is the descriptive record of a model, covering its identity, modelled phenomenon, intended use, formalism, abstraction and metamodeling level, epistemic state, provenance and declared assumptions.

comment.en: Editorial definition; the SysML v2 model declares this as a metadata definition nested in Model.

definition.value: A world model is a model whose referent is the extended system being operated in.
A performance constraint bounds the response time admissible when a model is used, for instance at run time.

comment.en: Editorial definition; the SysML v2 model states this as a constraint definition.

definition.value: An entity is any thing in the universe of discourse that can be distinguished from all other things in that universe.

Given an extended system, the context is the set of the content retained about that extended system, together with the assumptions and conditions, deemed relevant to interpret, evaluate and act within that extended system.
A modelet-engine pair is the pairing of a modelet with an engine that can exert it.
An action order is an executable directive, issued within a given context of an extended system, that activates the execution of the actions in a given action specification by the designated agents.
Estimation is a cognitive function realized by a modelet-engine pair whose purpose is to infer unknown or uncertain quantities of a referent from available data and prior knowledge.

A feature is a derived piece of information that encodes some characteristic of an entity, system, phenomenon, or context, obtained from observations or sensor data and used as input to functions or modelets.
Data are encoded representations of aspects of an entity or system (e.g., phenomena, properties, states, or attributes) in a form suitable for communication, storage, or processing.

An action trigger is a condition on the state and/or exhibited behavior of an extended system, identified within a given context, whose satisfaction indicates the need to initiate the execution of one or more actions to contribute to the achievement or maintenance of one or more goals.
A trajectory is a time-ordered sequence of states representing one possible evolution of the system over a time interval.
The potential behavior of a system over a time interval is the set of all trajectories the system may follow over that interval.
A mission success criterion pairs a metric with a satisfaction condition in a given context.
An adverse occurrence is an occurrence whose happening would negatively affect an entity, system, or extended system.

comment.en: Editorial definition; the SysML v2 model declares this element without prose.

definition.value: The exhibited behavior of a system over an observational interval is the trajectory followed by the system during that interval.
The state of a system at a time instant is the complete set of attribute values describing the current condition of its components and their relations.
A task is a set of planned actions, executed by one or more agents, that is intended to contribute to the achievement of one or more goals within a given context.
A self model is a model whose referent is the owning system itself, so that referent and user coincide.
A functionality is an instantiation of a capability with some expected performance that is intended to satisfy one or more goals within a given context.

An actuator is a physical entity that, when provided with an input, produces a physical effect on the environment or the system (e.g., motion, force, or flow), thereby executing actions commanded by an agent.
An engine is a component that exerts a modelet to derive a result.
An extended system is composed of a target system together with its selected environment and the relations between both of them.
A stakeholder is an entity for whom a system S is relevant because the behavior or outcomes of S can affect the achievement of its own goals.
The OMG Meta Object Facility metamodeling layer, M0 to M3, at which a model sits.
Performance is a measure of how effectively the exhibited behavior of a system (or one of its components) contributes to fulfilling its goals when executing tasks within a given context.

A policy is a rule or strategy that, for a given action trigger and a given context of an extended system, determines a set of candidate actions that are admissible responses to that trigger in that context.
A concern is a matter of interest to a stakeholder that, in a given context, can be derived from a need and may give rise to requirements.
A mission is a high-level goal expressed as desired effects or target conditions for an extended system within a given context.
A trigger condition is the condition, evaluated in a given context of an extended system, whose satisfaction fires an action trigger.

comment.en: Editorial definition; the SysML v2 model declares this as an abstract constraint definition to be redefined in usages.

definition.value: The environment of a system is the collection of entities that are not part of the system but are capable of influencing or being influenced by it.
An action order status records the execution status reached by a given action order.

comment.en: Editorial definition; the SysML v2 model declares this element without prose.

definition.value: A phenomenon is any distinguishable aspect or behavior of an extended system, or of one of its parts, within a given context.
A scalability constraint bounds the load, such as the number of concurrent users, admissible when a model is used.

comment.en: Editorial definition; the SysML v2 model states this as a constraint definition.

definition.value: Exertion is the process of executing one or more modelets to given inputs in order to derive results about their referent.
Sense is the action of acquiring raw sensor data about the phenomenon being observed in the extended system.
A risk is a measure of the potential for an adverse event to negatively affect an entity, system, or extended system within a given context.

A mission specification is the set of specific goals refining a given mission, together with the mission success criteria (expressed as metrics and their satisfaction conditions) that enable assessment of mission success.
The state of a binary relation at a given time instant is the tuple of the values of its attributes.
A super system is a system whose components are, themselves, systems.
The kind of performance measure used to assess a system: measure of effectiveness, measure of performance, or technical performance measure.
The epistemic standing of a model: validated, evidenced, uncertain or limited.
A metric is a measure used to assess mission success.
A mission plan is a collection of tasks, together with any required precedence relations among them, to be carried out in order to satisfy the mission within the given extended system and context.

Meaning is the informational content produced by exerting one or more modelets on input features, representing an interpretation of a phenomenon of the associated extended system within a given context.
A cognitive function is a function that processes information by executing one or more modelets.
A time interval is the stretch of time delimited by an initial time instant and a later final time instant, both on the same time scale.

comment.en: Editorial definition; the SysML v2 model states this structurally rather than in prose.

definition.value: Stakeholder value is the amount of benefit at a cost provided to stakeholders within a given context.
Projection is a representation that maps a given situation of an extended system in a given context, into a representation in a chosen space, over a specified projection domain.
An agent is an entity capable of executing or commanding actions.
A role is a context- and time-dependent designation, with associated responsibilities and constraints, that an entity may assume in order to contribute to the achievement or maintenance of a goal.
A modelet is a model fragment that represents a specific aspect of a referent system or entity.

An action specification is a concrete description, produced in response to an action trigger within a given context according to a chosen policy, that: (i) selects one or more actions from the candidate set determined by that policy, and (ii) assigns one or more responsible agents to each selected action.
The kind of model, by the nature of its representation.
Evaluation is an assessment of a projection with respect to a specific set of goals.
The state of an entity at a given time instant is the tuple of the values of its attributes.
A binary relation is a relation between two entities, holding from a source entity to a target entity.
The execution status reached by an action order.
The origin and lifecycle standing of a model: original, derived, historical or versioned.
A goal is a subset of the possible states of an extended system representing the conditions that an agent intends to achieve or maintain.
For a given stakeholder, the system of interest is the part of an extended system that constitutes the focus of engineering activities.
A model is an entity that represents another entity (its referent).
A capability is the ability of a system to perform a specific function successfully under stated conditions and acceptance criteria.
A sensor is an entity that acquires raw sensor data about phenomena, properties, states, or attributes of an entity being observed in the extended system.
A cognitive capability is a capability of a system that is realized by a cognitive function and enables the system to use knowledge to produce intentional action.
A responsibility carried by an entity that assumes a role.
The scope and detail level of a model, including the phenomena it includes and excludes.
A textual account of a term instance.
